description: The confirmed project context of the SecureDocs benchmark project (US-60). Used by eval/run_benchmark.py --context-pack on to render the same <project_context> block ContextPackBuilder sends with every prompt (summary, actors, glossary terms found in the text). Taken from sections 1-2 of srs_planted.md.
summary: SecureDocs is a web portal where employees of a company store, share and review confidential documents. It covers user accounts, sign-in, document storage, retention and notifications. Payroll, billing and the mobile apps are out of scope. It runs in a private cloud, is used through current desktop browsers, and all traffic uses TLS. The compliance office reviews audit logs.
actors: Employees, who upload and read documents every day
Workspace administrators, who manage the users and settings of one workspace
Guests, external partners who receive shared documents
The compliance office, which reviews audit logs

glossary.meaning: The time between a successful sign-in and sign-out or expiry.
An employee who manages the users of one workspace.
The place where deleted documents wait before permanent removal.
An external partner who receives shared documents.
The record of security-relevant events that the compliance office reviews.
